title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1979-01-15
source: Recorded by Steve Rolfe: Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-I90/Dolby B); Section 61 Row S Seat 7; Transfer and masteringg by David Minches: Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Korg MR-1000(DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo]) Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96] > Adobe Audition 6.0> FLAC encoding

ai_review.summary: Clear matrix mix captures three standout performances—Jack Straw, Row Jimmy, and Shakedown Street—despite an overall average show.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the recording a perfect five stars, praising the matrix blend that delivers crisp, well‑balanced sound. While noting the concert isn’t the Dead at their peak, they highlight exceptional versions of Jack Straw (especially its second solo), Row Jimmy, and Shakedown Street as the night’s gems.

ai_rating.rationale: 5‑star rating for an excellent matrix recording outweighs a modest appraisal of the overall performance, yielding a solid four‑star overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer loves the matrix mix, describing it as clear and well‑preserved from original tape; no noted dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall performance is viewed as not the band’s peak, but specific moments—especially the second solo in Jack Straw—provide high points that lift the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Second solo on Jack Straw singled out as a highlight.
